description: Signature edition. Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Foundations material that follows.

Proportion: measuring relationships so figures and objects read true.
key_laws: Sight-size: comparing drawing to subject at matched scale.
vocabulary: Contour: the edge line defining form.
Foreshortening: the compression of receding forms.
methods: Gesture drawing: timed poses training seeing and economy.
history: Drawing is humanity's oldest art, from cave walls to Renaissance workshops where it was the foundation skill. Academies drilled it for centuries, and it remains the root discipline of all visual art.

Proportion: measuring relationships so figures and objects read true.
